findings.text: lesson_intro alias interplay: the canonical beats-order check maps the lesson alias lesson_intro onto product_intro, but check_presentation_order does not, so a lesson-purpose record whose presentation.order names lesson_intro is refused presentation-unknown (verified live). Latent edge only: presentation blocks are new in this unit and no consumer declares one on a lesson record; the acceptance requires presentation.order to carry the twelve canonical ids. Not fixed: adding alias mapping to the presentation contract would be unrequested behavior beyond the acceptance.

When both presentation.order (inside the block) and a top-level presentation_order exist and disagree, the block's order wins silently (verified live: flat says ordinary_world, block says vindication, order used = vindication). Documented precedence in _presentation_block; no acceptance element covers the conflict and no consumer declares both.
